title: open-practices-repro-v1 task input
description: A MOCKED repository snapshot (no live fetch). The player must flag reproducibility / open-practices defects per target: hard-coded absolute paths, uncommented code, load()s of files absent from files[], broken/placeholder repository links, and data/code/materials availability statements whose open-practices claim is false (a dead/placeholder data link, data offered only 'upon request', or a materials claim with no link and no materials present).

repo_url.description: The repository link (a real link, or a placeholder/404-style broken link).

files.description: The mocked file listing of the repository.

name.description: File name / relative path inside the repo.

targets.description: The closed set of candidate targets to assess (every file name plus the repo_url), so scoring is well-defined. The player should return one record per target.
